# Plan instructions (CatPortfolio)

- Post a structured plan as an issue comment: goal, approach, files, risks, test plan.
- Respect SPA boundaries: layout YAML vs block registry vs fish-tank/WebGL vs OCT/Whiskers client vs CI/deploy.
- Do not mix WelTel job copy, Whiskers Agent product code, and this SPA's implementation in one change.
- Ask clarifying questions only when blocked.
- Do not open a PR unless the user (or issue body) explicitly asks to implement.
